mobileLowEnd.memoryEmulation: resource-constrained emulation: CDP network throttle + 4x CPU throttle + heap-pressure read (1.5x Netherlands-28 DOM resident) + single-document discipline; NOT a viewport-resize-only or deviceMemory-spoof claim

inpMethod: Event Timing API, event-timing-attributed (PerformanceObserver type event, durationThreshold 0, trusted input; observer starts after setup, entries filtered by event.target + interactionId, setup excluded, click excluded)

memory.decodedImageMethod: MODEL ESTIMATE: sum of current-src naturalWidth × naturalHeight × 4 (2 imgs). NOT browser/GPU resident memory; excludes shared-cache reuse and cross-URL dedupe uncertainty. transferredImageBytes = encodedBodySize (compressed HTTP transfer), never called decoded memory.
memory.heapPressure: 1.5x Netherlands-28 DOM (detached clone, held by JS reference only — NOT appended to the document) resident during measurement
